subject.title: clawhub install does not register skill hooks automatically

question: Should ClawHub install/update register skill-provided OpenClaw hook bundles, and what consent, scanner disclosure, and gateway handoff contract is required first?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested automatic registration crosses a publisher-controlled execution and session-influence boundary that cannot be safely resolved as a narrow CLI-only fix.

options.title: Approve explicit hook registration contract
options.body: Define typed hook metadata, scanner disclosure, user consent, gateway targeting, and failure behavior before implementing install/update registration.

options.title: Keep manual plugin registration
options.body: Document manual `openclaw plugins install` or the inspectable setup prompt as the supported path and defer automatic registration.

options.title: Split registry disclosure first
options.body: Implement hook metadata parsing, validation, and UI/API disclosure first, leaving actual gateway registration for a later OpenClaw handoff decision.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit hook registration contract
recommendation.body: Define typed hook metadata, scanner disclosure, user consent, gateway targeting, and failure behavior before implementing install/update registration.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the CLI/schema surfaces and has already engaged on the adjacent install/update handoff direction.
